title: Link batch answer
description: The body a gateway's 2xx to a link batch may carry, application/json: on the local link unsigned, behind a separate gateway signed as every answer on a bound connection (README §The gateway's link). An empty body, or one without stop, means the session goes on. With stop, the session stops the runtime as at the run's time limit and writes dev.qory.session.exited with stop.reason as its reason: paused with model_key_limit and model_key_switch, failed with model_key_unauthorized. A member Forager does not recognise is ignored.

stop.description: Why the session stops its runtime. The run stays open.

reason.description: model_key_limit: the gateway's proxy passed a model provider's limit refusal to the session, because no key of the key group is left, or the refused request's body was over the 8 MiB the gateway copies for a resend (README §Credentials, Several model keys). model_key_switch: the model provider returned 401 for the session's key, which is out of the run, another key of the group is usable, and the key group's API format is one whose requests the gateway does not send again with another key, openai-responses; the run pauses, and a control plane can start its continuation at once on another key. model_key_unauthorized: every key of the key group is out of the run after a 401 of the model provider that no renewal brought back; the run ends with no continuation (README §Credentials, Keys out after a 401).
